entries.context: If you’re looking to create something truly unique, or wanting to customise an existing build, Bricks and Pieces is your go-to destination! Discover an extensive selection of individual bricks and minifigure pieces to mix, match, and create your next masterpiece. Whether you're a seasoned builder or just starting your LEGO® journey, you'll find everything you need right here. Explore Pick a Brick inspiration , browse the collection of mini-builds or take a look at what bricks and pieces are trending here.

entries.context: Outside of the baseplates, the largest LEGO piece is the Boat Hull, which measures an impressive 28 x 8 x 3 in studs. This large piece provides a solid foundation for creating intricate boat designs and adds significant size to any LEGO build! If you're looking to add this piece to your build, search for the element ID 6421400 on Pick a Brick.
